condition: Release supplies a structured case-linked protocol-defined radiographic geometric quantity such as an angle distance displacement alignment or ratio
action: Assign ASL-3; record provenance and any acquisition or calibration context separately

condition: Release supplies boxes masks polygons landmarks line segments or axes and ASL-3 is not satisfied
Release supplies reports ordinal grades bone age or another indirect target and neither ASL-3 nor ASL-2 is satisfied
Release supplies only image-level semantic categories
Model-task output combines a radiographic measurement with clinical context to produce a diagnostic management or workflow decision
Model-task pair returns a protocol-defined radiographic geometric quantity and CDL-4 is not satisfied
Model-task pair returns a detection mask landmark line axis or other exposed spatial output and no earlier condition in the priority order is satisfied
Model-task pair returns or retrieves language-grounded content and no earlier condition in the priority order is satisfied
Model-task pair returns image-level semantic predictions
Evidence directly tests human decisions workflow safety or clinical impact
Evidence compares the final protocol-defined geometric quantity with a reference using measurement-level statistics and EVL-4 is not satisfied
action: Assign EVL-3 and record limitations of the reported statistics

condition: Evidence tests an exposed spatial output with localization detection segmentation centerline or axis metrics and no earlier condition in the priority order is satisfied
Evidence tests language retrieval report or VQA output and no earlier condition in the priority order is satisfied
Evidence tests image-level semantic output with classification metrics
Number appears only in narrative text
action: Keep at ASL-1 unless a structured case-linked field table or file is released

condition: Several annotation forms are available
action: Report the highest-priority satisfied ASL category as primary and retain other forms as secondary support

condition: Final values have different provenance
action: Clinician-entered consensus-derived organizer-derived and algorithm-derived values satisfy the ASL-3 release-interface criterion; record provenance without implying equal information content or reference quality

condition: Investigator reconstructs a measurement from spatial annotations
action: Keep released support at ASL-2; a final structured value packaged by the release triggers ASL-3 and records availability not independent annotation information

condition: A study mixes clinical radiographs and simulated projections
action: Use only clinically acquired two-dimensional radiograph evidence in the clinical inventory and record simulated evidence as excluded scope

condition: One paper or model contains several tasks or outputs
action: Assign CDL separately to each model-task pair

condition: Resource requires registration application or a data-use agreement
action: Include when a documented research access route exists; label research-accessible and record the restriction

condition: Output and evaluation concern different objects
action: Assign CDL to the returned output and EVL to the object directly tested; spatial evidence is not EVL-3 without final-measurement evaluation
